_comment: Deterministic claim filters for the assist service (verify.mjs / grounding.mjs). Placeholder version.
This file is DATA, not code, so the list can be corrected without touching the filter.
Put in `neverClaim` every tool/skill/language the candidate genuinely does NOT have, plus terms the CV backs only partially.
A draft that contains a term here is rejected, not warned: suppressing a true claim is recoverable, asserting a false one to an employer is not.
UNRESOLVED-CONFLICT PATTERN worth copying: when the source docs disagree (the CV digest maps skill X to a job, but the design spec lists X as
NEVER-CLAIM), the spec wins and the term stays banned until the user rules. Record the conflict here in the _comment so nobody 'fixes' either side.
'caseSensitive' exists for short words that are also ordinary English: 'Go' the language vs 'go' the verb. Matching it case-insensitively
would flag every honest sentence containing the word. 'requireContext' narrows a term to sentences that also contain one of the listed words.

neverClaim.note: a past JD required it; the CV has none
ambiguous with an English word; only flag when a skill-claim word is in the same sentence

_mergeComment: 'The three facts that must never merge'. A draft that merges them is REJECTED, not warned:
these are the fabrications that read most plausibly to a recruiter.
A violation fires when terms from two different groups appear in the SAME SENTENCE.
